author: Origen of Alexandria
occasion: The work consists of brief explanatory notes on selected verses of Joshua, apparently intended to clarify difficult points and draw out typological meanings for Christian readers.
argument: Origen explains that the verse 'And all the people left their tents' means 'as a floor full of corn'—the Jordan waters were not merely congealed as at the Red Sea but piled up like a heap of wheat, as a type of the apostles. He asks why Jericho was devoted to destruction and answers that, just as he commanded them to offer firstfruits of the crops, so he ordered them to offer the firstfruits of the spoils; the command trained Israel to keep the necessary laws; and the city fell by trumpet sound alone to show divine power and that future defeats would be their own fault for despising divine laws. He notes that at Ai livestock could be taken as plunder because it was not necessary for everything to be devoted as at Jericho. Finally, he explains that Joshua kept his hand outstretched so that, when those of the ambush saw it, they would seize the city first.

_unresolved_facts.claim: the verse 'And all the people left their tents' means 'as a floor full of corn'—the Jordan waters were not merely congealed as at the Red Sea but piled up like a heap of wheat
_unresolved_facts.source_quote: Στίχ. ιδ΄. Καὶ ἀπῆρε πᾶς λαὸς ἐκ τῶν σκηνωμάτων αὐτῶν. Τουτέστιν, ὡς ἅλω πλήρωσις (69). Οὐ γὰρ μόνον ἐπήγνυτο, ὡς ἐν τῇ Ἐρυθρᾷ, ἀλλʼ ὡς θημὼν πυροῦ ἐσωρεύετο.
_unresolved_facts.fix: The verse 'And all the people left their tents' is the lemma; the explanation 'as a floor full of corn' (ὡς ἅλω πλήρωσις) refers to the Jordan waters, not to the verse about leaving tents. The waters were not merely congealed as at the Red Sea but piled up like a heap of wheat, as a type of the apostles.

_unresolved_facts.claim: Joshua kept his hand outstretched so that, when those of the ambush saw it, they would seize the city first
_unresolved_facts.source_quote: Ἔμενε γὰρ Ἰησοῦς ἐκτεταμένην ἔχων τὴν χεῖρα· ἵνα, θεασάμενοι οἱ τῆς ἐνέδρας, προκαταλάβωνται τὴν πόλιν.
_unresolved_facts.fix: Joshua kept his hand outstretched so that, when those of the ambush saw it, they would seize the city in advance / beforehand (προκαταλάβωνται), not 'first'
